patch.value: GH-1073: pm init accepts a whitespace id prefix that makes later creates fail
GitHub issue #1073 reports that init persists a natural-language prefix containing spaces, then every later create fails the stricter normalized-ID contract.

Share one prefix validation primitive between SDK init and lifecycle create; fail before tracker persistence or normalize deterministically; cover CLI/SDK/MCP and packed npx/bunx behavior; document accepted prefix grammar and recovery.
Initialize a fresh tracker with a whitespace-containing prefix, then create an item with or without an explicit ID; observe the downstream normalization refusal.
Init normalizes or rejects an invalid prefix before committing tracker state, using the same actionable ID contract as create.
Init succeeds and persists a prefix that makes ordinary item creation fail.
